text:
maria: Heads-up: multiple customers reporting 502/504 spikes and long tail latencies for hosted inference in eu-west2 this morning. Seeing a sharp increase starting ~08:10 UTC. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/hosted-eu-west2 — can network ops take a look? :eyes:
kevin: I see the same in SLO graphs — p95 token timeouts up, request 5xx rate +3.2x. Any auth errors too?
lucy: Customers also reported repeated 'Upstream timeout' in our gateway logs. Sample log: ```gateway_id=gw-azb eu-west2 recv_timeout upstream=10.2s status=504```
sam: Running quick traceroutes from a couple of affected hosts to model endpoints: ```traceroute -n model-euw2-01.redwood.net 8.8.8.8
 1 10.0.0.1 0.5 ms
 2 192.0.2.5 3.2 ms
 3 198.51.100.10 120 ms * *
 4 203.0.113.8 130 ms 125 ms 128 ms``` shows a big hop jump (~120ms) and some packet loss on hop 3.
maria: @netops can you correlate with provider BGP/flap alerts? Also customers complaining about auth retries — suspect retries amplify.
netops: Checking provider feeds now. I see recent BGP withdraws from AS64521 affecting eu-west2-edge-pop-3 around 08:07-08:25 UTC. Provider ticket #PROV-3921 shows partial multipath failover.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0458 — Severity: P2 — owners: @netops, @kevin. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0458
kevin: Can we failover traffic away from that edge POP for hosted inference routes? We have routing policy 'regional-fallback' that can favor eu-west1 when eu-west2 latency spike >100ms for >5m.
lucy: Rolling an emergency RLS change to prefer eu-west1 for heavy inference routes — will update canary first (5% traffic).
sam: Quick test results after canary: tail latency down for canary group, 5xxs reduced by ~60% for those requests. Still seeing higher retry volume for persisted connections to original POP.
maria: Good. Netops — can you push provider escalation and request confirmation of route stabilization ETA? Customers need ETA for rollback to normal.
netops: Already on the call with provider. They confirmed a flapping link causing ECMP imbalance due to a hardware queue bug on their router. They plan a microcode patch and hard-reboot of affected linecard at 09:15 UTC. ETA ~30-45m for full stabilization.
kevin: Mitigation plan: 1) Keep regional-fallback in place for now. 2) Increase gateway connection timeouts for warm retries to reduce cascading retries (temporary). 3) CS to notify impacted customers with ETA.
lucy: Deploying gateway timeout bump to 20s for hosted inference route (canary then 100%). Command snippet: ```curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.internal/gateway/config -d '{"route":"/v1/infer","upstream_timeout":20}'``` will push in 2-3 minutes.
sam: Observed metrics after gateway change: connection retries down ~25%, 504s trending down but not fully resolved. Packet loss at provider hop persists.
maria: Customer comms draft: "We're investigating regional network degradation affecting eu-west2 where a transit provider reports a flapping link. We've applied routing fallbacks and expect mitigation while provider patches hardware. ETA ~45m. We'll update asap." Approve?
kevin: Approve. Send from CS with link to status page.
netops: Provider just posted patch started at 09:18 UTC. I'm seeing BGP announcements stabilizing.
oncall-bot: Update INC-2026-0458: provider patch applied, monitoring.
lucy: Rolling rollback: will revert regional-fallback once p95 latency stays <150ms for 15m. Starting monitoring window.
sam: p95 now down 45% vs peak, 5xx rate near normal for canary.
maria: Nice work. Once stabilized, let's collect traceroutes and pcap from affected edge for the postmortem. @netops can you hold packet captures for the 08:00–09:30 window?
netops: Yep — capturing and saving to /mnt/pcaps/INC-2026-0458/eu-west2.tar.gz. Will include provider's BGP dumps and timing.
kevin: Postmortem action items: (1) add provider flapping play to runbook, (2) test quicker automatic fallback thresholds, (3) consider pre-warm alternative regional capacity for heavy customers.
maria: Agreed. I'll create PM-2026-78 for the postmortem and link incident artifacts. Closing updates to customers in 15m unless we see regression. Thanks team :raised_hands:
